2.name: elena drives to lighthouse
2.description: Elena arrives by red Jeep along the coastal road toward the lighthouse, establishing her destination.
evidence: A RED JEEP rounds the final curve of a winding coastal highway.
Ahead, the lighthouse rises from a rocky promontory.

2.name: elena checks notebook
2.description: Inside the Jeep, Elena glances at her notebook, reinforcing her identity as a reporter on assignment.
evidence: On the passenger seat: a GREEN SPIRAL NOTEBOOK, its cover marked ELENA VOSS -- COASTAL HERALD. She glances at it.

2.name: elena confirms destination
2.description: Elena mutters that Calloway is the end of the road, signaling she has reached the place she came to investigate.
evidence:
ELENA
(muttering)
Calloway. End of the road.

2.name: elena turns onto gravel track
2.description: Elena leaves the main coastal highway and turns down the gravel track toward the lighthouse entrance.
evidence: She turns down the gravel track.

2.name: elena arrives at lighthouse entrance
2.description: Elena parks by the outbuilding and gets out carrying her notebook, beginning her in-person visit.
evidence: Elena parks beside a weathered outbuilding and climbs out, GREEN SPIRAL NOTEBOOK tucked under her arm.

2.name: marcus confronts elena
2.description: Marcus appears in the doorway with an anchor at his side and challenges Elena by asking if she is the journalist.
evidence: MARCUS appears in the doorway, ANCHOR at his side.

2.name: elena identifies herself
2.description: Elena introduces herself as a Coastal Herald journalist and references Claire Munroe to establish legitimacy.
evidence:
ELENA
Elena Voss. Coastal Herald. You spoke to my editor -- Claire Munroe?

2.name: marcus acknowledges editor referral
2.description: Marcus confirms Claire's recommendation, indicating Elena's visit was arranged and that he has some expectation of her.
evidence:
MARCUS
She said you were thorough.

2.name: elena responds with dry wit
2.description: Elena replies that such praise is just what opens doors, revealing her pragmatic, sardonic personality.
evidence:
ELENA
She says what opens the door.

2.name: marcus invites elena inside
2.description: After a brief pause, Marcus softens and invites Elena in, noting that a storm is already in the air.
evidence:
MARCUS
Come in then. Storm's already in the air.
